## 2.3 Data Cleaning



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
water_indicators[water_indicators == ".."] <- NA
water_indicators[water_indicators == "#N/A"] <- NA
water_indicators[water_indicators == ""] <- NA
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
colnames(water_indicators) <- gsub("^X", "", colnames(water_indicators))
water_indicators_long <- water_indicators %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("20"),  # Select columns starting with "20" (years)
               names_to = "year",         # New column for years
               values_to = "value")       # New column for values
```
:::



Grouping  the years into categories and creating a new categorical column (year_group)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
water_indicators_long1 <- water_indicators_long %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  mutate(year_group = case_when(
    year >= 2000 & year <= 2005 ~ "2000-2005",
    year >= 2006 & year <= 2010 ~ "2006-2010",
    year >= 2011 & year <= 2015 ~ "2011-2015",
    year >= 2016 & year <= 2021 ~ "2016-2021",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Handle unexpected years
  ))
```
:::



# 3. Oneway ANOVA Test: ggbetweenstats() method over past Twenty years

ANOVA (Analysis of Variance) tests if the mean values of different groups are significantly different as we need statistical proof of differences, determining whether observed differences are statistically significant.

## 3.1 People using at least basic sanitation services (% of population) 

### 3.1.1 Sub-Saharan Africa



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
water_long_selected1 <- water_indicators_long1 %>%
  filter(Series.Name == 'People using at least basic sanitation services (% of population)',
         Region == 'Sub-Saharan Africa')
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggbetweenstats(
  data = water_long_selected1,
  x = year_group, 
  y = value, 
  type = "p",
  mean.ci = TRUE, 
  pairwise.comparisons = TRUE, 
  pairwise.display = "significant", 
  p.adjust.method = "fdr",
  messages = FALSE,
  title = "Comparison of Basic Sanitation Services for Sub-Saharan Africa by Year Group"
)
```
